claim: Bulk-cancel must not change the status of an order that belongs to a different user.
Stock must not be restored when bulk-cancel processes an order owned by a different user.
Calling bulk-cancel twice with the same order IDs must not restore stock more than once.
A delivered order included in a bulk-cancel request must be silently skipped and its stock must not be restored.
When bulk-cancel receives IDs belonging to multiple users, only the requesting user's placed orders are cancelled and have stock restored.
